content.title: Apollo Commerical Finance: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Apollo Commercial Real Estate Finance (ARI) on Thursday reported third-quarter net income of $50.8 million, after reporting a loss in the same period a year earlier. The New York-based company said it had profit of 34 cents per share. Earnings, adjusted for non-recurring gains, were 30 cents per share.
